newsitem.title: HAITI: Riots break out in Port-au-Prince.
newsitem.headline: Riots break out in Port-au-Prince.

text.p: Police clashed with students who occupied a school in the Haitian capital Port-au-Prince on Thursday and several people were wounded, including a boy shot in the head, witnesses said.
Police fired tear gas and bullets. At least two other protesters received bullet wounds and several were beaten, the witnesses said.
Rioting spread to downtown streets and demonstrators set fire to cars, torched a courthouse and hurled rocks through shop windows.
Students ran through the streets with the boy who was shot, but he appeared to be still alive. Police later took him to a hospital.
Business owners shut their premises as the unrest grew.
The Petion School occupied by the students has been closed since Monday when teachers walked out saying they had not been paid for months.
